verdict.rationale: Worldsmith lets users build a simulated world from a natural-language description, which is a first-party way to drive one part of the product in plain language. Nothing shows that tasks, evaluations, comparisons or other operations can be run by natural-language command. Semantic search over events is a query feature, not operating the product. Missing for 10: natural-language control beyond world building (tasks, runs, comparisons, observability), documentation of how Worldsmith interprets descriptions and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Worldsmith builds that world from your description, from a single service to a workflow across connected tools.
